management_remarks: In Q1 FY26, Reliance Industries delivered 13.4% consolidated EBITDA growth driven by Jio ARPU expansion to Rs 209.5 and strong operating leverage in Reliance Retail. Free cash flow surged as telecom network capital expenditure moderated significantly compared to the prior 5G rollout cycle. Our domestic Oil & Gas and fuel retail operations delivered high cash conversion and superior return on capital employed.
analyst_qa: On O2C quarterly variability, seasonal monsoon demand and volatile middle-distillate cracks create challenging quarter-on-quarter swings. In quick-commerce retail, hyper-competitive discounting by peers presents margin headwinds, so we are maintaining a cautious, calibrated dark-store rollout. Timing of the next industry telecom tariff hike remains uncertain and subject to competitive market equilibrium.
